examples.title:
Examples
of applications
examples.description: Here there will be a description block with text about how many ways the product can be used.

items.item1Text: The back display function is activated by touch panel, hand gesture, thanks to a special motion sensor or voice command.
items.item2Text: The sensors are installed anywhere depending on the interior and switch off automatically if they do not track the person.
items.item3Text: The camera is covered by a flap and is visible when activated so that the person is not uncomfortable with the feeling of constant surveillance.
items.item4Text: The covering mirror is designed to be double-layered to hide the video feed screen and display it when needed.
items.item5Text: A smart light on the top and sides reacts to the video broadcast to avoid glare and highlights the person in front of the mirror.
items.item6Text: Video quality is customisable from 4k, 60fps and up to avoid broadcast lags.
